facts.fact: cleared 定义：锁定嫌疑人且有足够证据支持逮捕/定罪。
facts.anchor: A homicide is considered “cleared” when law enforcement has identified an offender

facts.fact: 2020 起跌破 50%——全国一半命案破不了。
facts.anchor: fewer than half of all homicides in the United States are solved.

facts.fact: 低破案率原因清单：嫌疑人/证人死亡或失踪、证据不足、证据链问题、资源缺乏（农村尤甚）。
facts.anchor: The death or disappearance of a suspect or witness

facts.fact: 调查能力与罪犯野心同步增长——越会抓越会逃。
facts.anchor: The better we get at catching them, the better they seem to be at getting away with it.
